<?php

$students = [
    ['Tanaka', 78, 85, 94], ['Suzuki', 88, 74, 82], ['Yamada', 65, 90, 71], ['Ito', 80, 79, 85],
    ['Kato', 92, 88, 95], ['Mori', 70, 62, 78],
];
foreach ($students as &$student) {
    $student['total'] = $student[1] + $student[2] + $student[3];
}
unset($student);
usort($students, fn($a, $b) => ($b['total'] <=> $a['total']) ?: strcmp($a[0], $b[0]));
$rank = 0;
$previous = -1;
foreach ($students as $position => $student) {
    if ($student['total'] !== $previous) {
        $rank = $position + 1;
    }
    printf("%d. %s total=%d average=%.2F\n", $rank, $student[0], $student['total'], $student['total'] / 3);
    $previous = $student['total'];
}
